test_mcp_proxy_disabled: test the cors-proxy endpoint returns 404 when webui_mcp_proxy is disabled
test_mcp_proxy_enabled: test the cors-proxy endpoint forwards requests to external URLs when webui_mcp_proxy is enabled
test_mcp_proxy_internal: test the cors-proxy endpoint forwards requests to internal server endpoints like /models
test_cors_proxy_status_codes: test the cors-proxy endpoint returns correct HTTP status codes for enabled and disabled proxy modes
test_cors_proxy_response_content: test the cors-proxy endpoint returns expected response content such as Example Domain or data field
